COLLECTOR-BAG_OF_TRICKS.title: Bag of Tricks
COLLECTOR-BAG_OF_TRICKS.description: The first [blue]3[/blue] times you [gold]Pyre[/gold] each combat, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
COLLECTOR-BLOCKED_CHAKRA.title: Blocked Chakra
COLLECTOR-BLOCKED_CHAKRA.description: At the start of your turn [gold]Kindle[/gold] 3. Every time [blue]Torchhead[/blue] loses [blue]3[/blue] HP, you lose [red]1[/red] HP.
COLLECTOR-BLOCKED_CHAKRA.flavor: One pulled muscle is all it takes.
COLLECTOR-BOTTLED_BRAIN.title: Bottled Brain
COLLECTOR-BOTTLED_BRAIN.description: Upon pickup, Upgrade a card in your Collection. Start combats with it on top of your Collected pile.
COLLECTOR-EMERALD_TORCH.title: Emerald Torch
COLLECTOR-EMERALD_TORCH.description:
At the start of combat [gold]Kindle[/gold] [blue]{Kindle:diff()}[/blue].
You can collect additional cards from [gold]Elite[/gold] and [gold]Boss[/gold] enemies.
COLLECTOR-EMERALD_TORCH.flavor: The fires of greed never fade.
COLLECTOR-JADE_RING.title: Jade Ring
COLLECTOR-JADE_RING.description: [gold]Miasma[/gold] increases by the number of debuffs the creature has after taking damage.
COLLECTOR-JADE_RING.flavor: Jade is the symbol of honesty.
COLLECTOR-KRAMPIAN_COAL.title: Krampian Coal
COLLECTOR-KRAMPIAN_COAL.description: When you [gold]Pyre[/gold] a [gold]Status[/gold] or [gold]Curse[/gold] card, add a [gold]Lucky Wick[/gold] to your hand, if the [gold]Pyred[/gold] card was a [gold]Curse[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
COLLECTOR-KRAMPIAN_COAL.flavor: "Intriguing! But why only specific chimneys?" - Ranwid
COLLECTOR-PRISMATIC_TORCH.title: Prismatic Torch
COLLECTOR-PRISMATIC_TORCH.description:
At the start of combat [gold]Kindle[/gold] [blue]{Kindle:diff()}[/blue].
You can collect additional [gold]Upgraded[/gold] cards from [gold]Elite[/gold] and [gold]Boss[/gold] enemies.
COLLECTOR-PRISMATIC_TORCH.flavor: The ever-changing flames reflect fortune's favor.
COLLECTOR-SOUL_LIT_LAMP.title: Soul-lit Lamp
COLLECTOR-SOUL_LIT_LAMP.description: Whenever you [gold]Pyre[/gold] a card that costs {Energy:energyIcons()} or more, apply {SoulburnPower:diff()} [gold]Soulburn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
COLLECTOR-SOUL_LIT_LAMP.flavor: A ghoulish decoration. The crackles of fire are replaced by buzzing wails.
COLLECTOR-THE_CONTRACT.title: The Contract
COLLECTOR-THE_CONTRACT.description: The first [gold]Colourless[/gold] card played each combat gives {Energy:energyIcons()} equal to its cost.
COLLECTOR-THIMBLE_HELM.title: Thimble Helm
COLLECTOR-THIMBLE_HELM.description: While [gold]Torchhead[/gold] is alive, cards grant [blue]1[/blue] additional [gold]Block[/gold].
COLLECTOR-THIMBLE_HELM.flavor: Worn by the Spire's miniest heroes.
SEA_GLASS.COLLECTOR-COLLECTOR.title: Greed Glass
